architecture: Independent bounded non-token causal-response hypothesis tournament with non-gradient integer credit assignment, evidence-triggered contradiction penalties, two protected stage memory banks, online hypothesis elimination, and cold rehydration; no graph objects or decoder-style next-token architecture
shared_source: Use existing general-DAG response-signature grammar build_hypotheses() unmodified and frozen 768 source hypotheses so candidate does not receive privileged novel transfer graphs

train.physical_custody: Pre-existing paid_training_episodes() only; 240 synthetic episodes 3301-3540, 1920 paid action receipts, phase 0/1 visible; uses identical data to Bayes, RNN, RL
train.scored_segments: 480 four-action stage segments; per hypothesis each 6-bit physical response is compared for matches and contradictions
train.credit_rule: For each public response bit: +1 if predicted bit equals observation, -2 otherwise; sum separately in phase-0 and phase-1 persistent banks; no reward or hidden-label leakage
train.deterministic_rank: decreasing integer score then increasing hypothesis index

online.stage0_active: top 96 learned phase-0 memory indices plus top 32 global recovery signatures; stable unique index order
online.stage1_active: top 96 learned phase-1 memory indices, top 32 prior-phase selected indices, plus top 32 global recovery; canonical dedup
online.score: base training credit transformed by dividing by 1920 and multiplying by 16, plus +1 for every matching public bit and -2 per contradictory public bit; online outcome evidence only from World.step receipt
online.stage_change: after first physical actuator phase changes without indicator; restart online penalty, recall phase-1 memory without erasing phase-0 memory; retain top 32 prior-phase hypotheses as protected reservoir
online.action_vote: hard tournament active top-32 scored hypotheses, each one vote, best available actuator based on fraction predicting target; deterministic choose lower actuator index on ties
online.diagnostic_policy: For each of six allowed internal-node pulse actions compute best post-pulse actuator success fraction by partitioning only the local hypothesis signatures; diagnostic expected utility = 1.5 * (expected post-probe winner fraction - current best fraction) - 0.05. If gain > 1e-9 select maximum, lexicographic tie; otherwise actuate
online.cost: actual World.step diagnostic 0.05, actuator 0.02, goal +1, miss -0.5
online.public_interface: Policy gets only observation dict, physically charged action return, signed public receipt; no private graph/seed/future; model simulation allowed on internal hypothesis signatures not physics oracle
online.rehydration: JSON canonical integer stage-bank credits, graph signature digest, top-memory index sets and configuration; cold restoring MUST produce byte-identical public action traces, no refitting

evaluation.old_toy_role: Reproducibility only, known 60-episode diagnostic; no primary inference
evaluation.new_toy_role: One-shot exploratory nonofficial check, 60 additional seeds with same 3 transfer motifs and parity-dependent rewire; freeze now before candidate exists
evaluation.statistical_method: paired difference in mean net utility candidate minus already-qualified Bayesian; per-motif and across rewired/stable breakdown; no p-hacking, no post-result selection
evaluation.novelty_threshold: Development-only threshold candidate >= Bayesian by 0.05 net utility plus no motif deficit > 0.03; cannot itself confer SCIENTIFIC_PASS
evaluation.if_null: REPORT DEVELOPMENT_NO_NOVEL_GAIN, retain code, source and outcomes, do not tune this line on observed result

qualification.official_first_use: NO; require separate explicit owner authority and independent source-locked original-cohort freeze
qualification.native_model_integration: NO; requires independent scientific qualification and authority
qualification.scope: research PR only, no main merge, accepted ref, local owner runner/controller, schedule, deployed learning or third party projects
